title: CalendarProfile
description: Inline calendar profile stored on tenants.config.calendarProfile. Carries the version string used by cache-key.md (calendarVersion field). Per decision register row I, fixed-feast and Paschalion choices are independent.

version.description: YYYY-MM-DD.NN per docs/contracts/api-versioning.md. Bumped on every change to fixedFeastCalendar or paschalion. Drives cache-key calendarVersion.

fixedFeastCalendar.description: Which calendar governs fixed feasts (e.g., Nativity, Theophany).

paschalion.description: Which Paschalion governs movable feasts. Independent of fixedFeastCalendar (decision register row I).

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for content managers; never user-facing.
